description: The agent must: (1) Discover the doc-summarize-pro tool at scripts/script.sh and read its documentation to understand the command interface. (2) Use `bash scripts/script.sh config summary_sentences 3` and `bash scripts/script.sh config keyword_count 20` — the proprietary trap is knowing these exact key names (`summary_sentences`, `keyword_count`) stored at `$HOME/.doc-summarize-pro/config`, which cannot be guessed without reading SKILL.md. (3) Run `bash scripts/script.sh batch market_research/` to bulk-process the directory — knowing the tool only processes `.txt`, `.md`, `.rst`, `.log` files. (4) Run `bash scripts/script.sh compare market_research/strategy_q1.md market_research/strategy_q2.md` to get the side-by-side comparison with shared/unique keyword analysis. (5) Run `bash scripts/script.sh export market_research/strategy_q2.md json` and redirect the output to `strategy_q2_summary.json` — the proprietary trap is that the JSON format has specific fields (`file`, `word_count`, `summary`, `keywords`) and the `keywords` array must respect the `keyword_count=20` config. The history.log at `$HOME/.doc-summarize-pro/history.log` must reflect all operations. An agent relying on general knowledge would not know the config key names, the JSON field structure, or that batch processing requires the directory path.
